notes: Null means not measured, never zero.
Native and Deno backend pairs use the same 7,469,246-byte valid Canonical fixture; each source records ten changed and ten unchanged samples. Their scopes are separate.

Final Deno 50aa four-run pair shows an unresolved diagnostics-on changed-save tail regression: +3.11% median and +21.12% nearest-rank p95; diagnostics-off changed median +1.41% and p95 −7.70%. Keep modes separate; do not claim cause or significance. No-op improves in both.

The final Deno candidate on-run logical counters show no-op has one full read/hash and zero target writes/copies/syncs/renames; changed-save has two full reads/hash, stage+backup writes, and the separately listed project/journal syncs. Service and probe observations are not additive.
Native measurements are debug Rust test-backend values, not Tauri IPC, release GUI, or physical disk throughput.
F-large-io 256 MiB streaming proof is separate from the F-large Canonical save benchmark.
The private writer reuses the same-call validated canonical serialization only; no cross-request cache or raw external-byte shortcut is used.
